contact.name: Will Cygan
contact.work_authorization: U.S. citizen · Authorized to work in the U.S. · No sponsorship required

profile: Senior Software Engineer with 5 years of experience across backend, platform, infrastructure, and product engineering. Builds high-scale, resilient systems spanning APIs, relational databases, streaming, and batch processing. Delivers internal platforms and growth products tied to engagement and revenue.

accomplishments: Designed and implemented a churn-recovery alerting platform from inception, generating $2M in annual revenue; scaled serving to 100K QPS and streaming ingestion to ~500 writes/s.
Over the next two years, led technical onboarding for 3 partner teams across usage billing, winback offers, and cancellation reminders, growing platform-attributed annual revenue from $2M to $8M.
Led the zero-downtime migration of LinkedIn's 12 TB, 20B-row ordering database from Oracle to MySQL with zero data loss.
Designed a reusable Oracle-to-MySQL migration framework adopted by 10 domain teams, using shadow reads, phased rollout, rollback, and TTL-based routing to preserve strong consistency.
Introduced version-based optimistic locking across MySQL write paths, preventing silent conflicts caused by Temporal activity retries.
Built a cross-system deletion pipeline that purged 300K corrupt orders, then extended it to target ~6B dormant rows, roughly 33% of a 10+ year-old database.
Eliminated N+1 queries across all order-processing read paths, reducing average latency 40% (50 to 30 ms) and p95 latency 37% (200 to 125 ms).
Scaled a feed recommendation service to 3,000 QPS on LinkedIn's 50M+ DAU feed, increasing weekly learners 2.5% across 3 experiments.
Built Spark targeting pipelines processing ~50 TB across 20+ datasets per run, expanding personalized learning alerts from 10M to 22M members and lifting weekly learners 1.09%.
Improved feed engagement 0.2% at hundreds of millions of daily impressions by filtering audio-only content from video course recommendations.
